split.title: Split a PDF
split.description: Split a PDF into several documents, or name them after a value with the advanced split.

split.privacy: The area is read in the browser; splitting runs locally and the temporary workspace is then deleted.
split.stepValuesDescription: Enter a pages / value table, paste a list or let the tool read the value from an area of each page.
split.advancedHint: Split by value: pages / value table, list paste, automatic detection in an area or on the whole page, value type and name pattern with {valeur}.
split.pasteHelp: One line per document: pages then value, separated by ; | or a tab (direct copy from Excel). Example: 1-3;A320-001.
split.chunkHelp: Replaces the table with regular page ranges; then fill in the value column.
split.scopePageHelp: The value is searched in the whole page text: the first match is kept. Prefer a precise regular expression (e.g. DMC-[A-Z0-9-]+); "Full text" would return the whole page.
split.zoneHelp: Draw a rectangle on the preview or adjust the values. The area is applied to every page.
split.regexHelp: The first capturing group is used when present, otherwise the whole match. E.g. No\.\s*(\S+)
split.grouping_change: New document whenever the value changes
split.grouping_same: Group every page with the same value
split.detectSummary: {{documents}} document(s) detected, {{missing}} page(s) without value. Check the table below.
split.detectFailed: Reading the PDF text failed. Reload the PDF or use table mode.
split.detectNotReady: The PDF preview is not loaded yet. Wait, then run detection again.
split.detectNoText: No text in the area on any page. Move the area, or use table mode if the PDF is scanned (no text layer).
split.detectNoMatch: Text was read in the area, but no value matches the selected type. Check the value type or the regular expression (see "Value" under the preview).
split.stepPreviewDescription: Browse pages to locate the boundaries of each document.
split.stepPreviewZone: Draw the area containing the value; the reading of the current page is shown below.
split.stepPreviewPage: The value is searched on the whole page; the result for the current page is shown below.
split.previewEmpty: Load a PDF to display the preview.
split.stepOutputDescription: Each table row becomes a PDF in the exported folder.
split.folderHelp: This name also determines the ZIP filename.
split.tableEmpty: No document yet. Add rows, paste a list or detect values.
split.invalidRows_one: {{count}} row has an invalid page selection.
split.invalidRows_other: {{count}} rows have an invalid page selection.
split.noRows: Add at least one document to the table.
split.apiInvalidGroups: The list of documents to generate is invalid.
split.apiTooManyGroups: The split exceeds the maximum number of documents.
split.detectSingleValue: A single value ("{{value}}") was read on every page: the area probably covers a shared header. Move the area onto the value that changes.
split.simpleDescription: Every N pages or by custom ranges, downloaded as a ZIP folder.
split.rangesHelp: One PDF per range, separated by semicolons or newlines. Example: 1-4 ; 5-8 ; 9-12. A comma combines pages into one PDF: 1-3,5.
split.rangesInvalid: Check the ranges: existing pages, ascending bounds and no more than 5000 documents.
split.simpleInvalid: Enter a positive whole number and limit the export to 5000 documents.
split.simpleFolderHelp: This name is used for the folder inside the ZIP and for the archive filename.
split.advancedNeedsFile: Load a PDF in step 01 first.
